findings.text: follow-on: enrich_worker now calls prepare_signal_sources, which runs sweep_source_enrichment and opens its own GraphClient, so the existing mock-driven enrich_worker tests that patch detect_signal_sources and propagate_source_enrichment but not GraphClient now perform live graph I/O. Confirmed by running test_interleaved_batch_keeps_each_description_on_its_signal at head with NEO4J_URI blocked: it still passes, but the log shows 'Source preparation failed (non-fatal): Couldn't connect to 127.0.0.1:1' from parallel.py:4084, i.e. the sweep's connection is attempted and its failure swallowed by the broad except; test_signal_glossary.py:74 and test_catalogue_text_kept.py:103 drive enrich_worker the same way. The tests stay green here because writes route through the mocked propagate_source_enrichment, but their hermeticity now depends on an unreachable-or-ignorable graph.

follow-on: the sweep's EXISTS predicate (member.id <> rep.id AND member.status = $discovered) duplicates the discovered-member predicate in propagate_source_enrichment's follower-count query (parallel.py:2008-2015), so the two must be kept in step; a change to the member-selection rule in one would silently disagree with the other.

follow-on: the end-of-run call is prepare_signal_sources, which re-runs full detect_signal_sources before sweeping, so the run settles late members by re-deriving all sources rather than by a bare sweep; that is heavier than the plan's 'sweep ... again at the end of the run' and is exercised by no test, so a regression in the end-of-run wiring would not be caught.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty although both arms ran and are complete (baseline-test.log records revision 2ccf7033e and '2 failed'; final-gate.log records revision d5149281 and '3 passed'), so the promotion suite-delta reads null from the field it inspects; the arms are recorded only under test_logs and the added-failure count here derives from those logs.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 2ccf7033e6665c734ba3e31b71a7e79f5c0db171. e832fa4da adds sweep_source_enrichment and prepare_signal_sources (parallel.py:2129,2157), routes the enrich_worker detection call through prepare_signal_sources (parallel.py:4080) and adds the propagated count to state.enrich_stats.processed (parallel.py:4086), adds the end-of-run composer call (parallel.py:5744) with its processed update (parallel.py:5745), and adds the 109-line test file. d51492819 reverts the preflight to detect_signal_sources (parallel.py:5556) and drops its sweep logging, so a scan-only run writes no enrichment. The sweep Cypher matches SignalSource by facility, its representative by sg.representative_id, requires the representative's status IN [enriched, checked] and EXISTS a non-representative member at discovered, and returns properties(rep) as the enrichment payload; the sweep then delegates to propagate_source_enrichment, which advances the source to enriched, clears members_described, and moves discovered members to enriched with enrichment_source=signal_source_propagation. Idempotence holds because the EXISTS predicate requires a still-discovered member, so a settling sweep empties its own precondition. No plan, sprint or index state touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: Section 67 done-when: a test shows a member linked to a source after its representative was enriched receives the propagated enrichment on the next pass, and a second pass changes nothing. test_next_pass_enriches_member_linked_after_representative (parametrized discovered/enriched and enriched/checked) builds a two-call sequence: the first prepare_signal_sources returns (0,0,0) with no late member, then a member is added and the second call returns (0,0,1) with the late member's description, name, physics_domain and enrichment_source set to the representative's values, and the source's members_described cleared; a third call returns (0,0,0) and both the source and member snapshots are unchanged, with member_updates still 1. I re-ran the reviewed final gate at head d5149281 in a scratch tree extracted from the object store (3 passed, EXIT=0), re-ran the base arm by placing the head test on base source 2ccf7033e (2 failed, AttributeError no prepare_signal_sources, EXIT=1), and confirmed my own mutation removing the sweep's propagation call leaves both tests failing (2 failed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal_fidelity: The node was dispatched to add an idempotent sweep that propagates enrichment from an already-enriched representative to the members of its source still at discovered, run beside source detection at the start of each enrichment pass and again at the end of the run. It delivers sweep_source_enrichment (parallel.py:2129), which selects representatives whose status is enriched or checked and that have at least one still-discovered member, then calls the existing propagate_source_enrichment for each; prepare_signal_sources (parallel.py:2157) composes detect_signal_sources with the sweep and replaces the detection call in the enrich_worker loop (parallel.py:4080), and the same composer is invoked once after the workers stop and before post-enrichment individualization (parallel.py:5744). The first commit wired the composer into the preflight too; the second commit (d5149281) reverted that so a discover_only run stays read-only, which the review confirms: run_parallel_data_discovery returns at parallel.py:5681 before the final composer call at 5744. Not 20 because the run-start sweep is folded into the same composer used at end-of-run, so the end-of-run call also re-runs full source detection rather than a bare sweep, and the representative set is broadened to include checked as well as enriched beyond the plan's literal 'enriched representative'.

justifications.durability: Two parametrized tests pin the behaviour and the negative control shows the sweep is load-bearing: removing the propagation call leaves both tests failing (2 failed, EXIT=1) while the unmutated head passes them. The tests assert the propagated description, name, physics_domain, enrichment_source, the source transition to enriched with members_described cleared, the idempotent second pass, and a member_updates counter. Not 20 because the graph is a hand-rolled fake whose query matching must track the real Cypher (it already broke once when the sweep query gained RETURN DISTINCT), detect_signal_sources is patched out so only the sweep-to-propagate path is exercised, neither production call site (the enrich_worker composer call or the end-of-run composer call) is covered, and the scan-only read-only guarantee is asserted only by a neighbouring pipeline test rather than by a late-member-specific case.
justifications.evidence: The gate reproduces at reviewed head d5149281 in a scratch tree extracted from the object store (3 passed, EXIT=0) and the base arm reproduces by placing the head test on base source 2ccf7033e (2 failed ... EXIT=1); my independent mutation removing the sweep's propagation call leaves both new tests failing (2 failed ... EXIT=1) while the unmutated head passes them, so the guard is load-bearing. The new sweep Cypher EXPLAINs on the live graph (EXPLAIN_OK) with a positive control of 7534 SignalSource nodes, confirming the instrument sees data. The reviewed run's own logs are complete and consistent (baseline 2 failed, committed-gate 2 passed, mode-boundary-retry 3 passed, final 3 passed, nearby 52 passed). Not 20 because the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty so the promotion suite-delta reads null, and the base arm covers only the new test file where the head arm covers three tests.
justifications.fit: The change extends the existing owner rather than adding a second mechanism: it reuses detect_signal_sources and delegates every write to propagate_source_enrichment, adds only a thin composer, follows the module's Cypher idiom, EXPLAINs on the live graph, and carries conventional commit subjects with bodies and no phase, stage, ticket or version identifiers. Not 20 because sweep_source_enrichment opens its own GraphClient and then opens another per representative through propagate_source_enrichment (an N+1 session pattern), and the new call in enrich_worker made several existing hermetic tests open a live graph client.
